limits: Public search index does not comprehensively cover national web or private communities.
Language markers often returned English listings; these were not relabelled as local coverage.
No new reader review of Pantheon/Trace of Refusal/PingBlip was attributable in this bounded pass.
Similar book titles, generic HISTOR/Metis/Emberline names, histor.dev and unrelated MCP abbreviations were excluded.
No publications, messages, logins, account changes, paid queries or GitHub writes.
